content: {"episode_id":"ep-05035","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0). Per the ordering note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies. Given this documented indication, we request that the authorization-based denial be overturned and the claim reprocessed for payment of the outstanding balance of 555.69."}
